text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp. This year brought 
record-breaking heat, with the sun 
piercing relentlessly against our skin day 
after day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Damn it... what's with this 
heat?
choice_data_list:
Make sure you stay properly hydrated, 
alright?
Make sure you stay hydrated, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I know...... *sigh*

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
President Rudolf, are you really sure 
about this!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I heard that your progress has 
stalled. If it wouldn't be presumptuous, 
please allow me to assist you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I learn so much from the President's 
guidance, so I'm really happy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
President, what about your own training 
time...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is no cause for concern. Watching 
others run is a meaningful experience for 
me as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Besides, I have a secret plan of my own.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Even after changing, this 
uncomfortable feeling still clings to 
me...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, there you are. Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Rudolf? If it's paperwork, I won't take 
it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Decisive and resolute, excellent. 
It's not as though I roped you into the 
Student Council just to chain you to a 
desk, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I look to you to show a path to the 
future that I myself cannot."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. Let us return to the main 
topic. Tomorrow, do you have time to run a 
mock race with me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Do you dislike it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hah... not at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'd gladly take you up on that. You're 
fine with this, right, Trainer...!
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haha, as if I'd let this chance slip 
by...! I will...—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: What's wrong?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...It is nothing. I will head out for 
afternoon training ahead of you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, handle the negotiations in my 
place. Just report back once everything is 
decided.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Self-centered as ever, I see. Looks 
like you're being dragged along quite a 
bit, too.
choice_data_list: Because that's just who Narita Brian is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's true.

And so, having arranged the mock race with 
Symboli Rudolf, I hurried back to Narita 
Brian—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: U-Uuu...
choice_data_list: Brian!?

text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian collapsed onto the beach, as 
if all the tension holding her together 
had snapped.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, mnh... Where is this...?

text_block_list.name: Medical Staff
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Brian-san has regained 
consciousness!
choice_data_list: Thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Medical Staff
text_block_list.text:
Poor health... likely summer fatigue and a 
mild case of heatstroke.

text_block_list.name: Medical Staff
text_block_list.text:
"However, please avoid strenuous exercise 
for now. It would be dangerous if 
something happened from pushing yourself 
too hard."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ! But the mock race is tomorrow...!
choice_data_list: ...Let's turn it down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Rest over mild symptoms like this? You 
underestimate me far too much!
choice_data_list: Even so, I'm worried about your health.

Even so, I'm worried about your health, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Don't mess around with me!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Such worries are totally unnecessary! 
Don't take running away from me!
choice_data_list:
I'm telling you this precisely because I 
don't want to take it from you!

I'm telling you this precisely because I 
don't want to take it from you!

text_block_list.text:
Umamusume racing is a battle of extreme 
speed. Because of that, a terrifying 
amount of strain is placed on their legs.

Besides, Narita Brian is an Umamusume who 
gives her all no matter the circumstances. 
If she were to somehow take a fall in this 
state...
choice_data_list:
As your trainer, I can't compromise on 
this.

As your Trainer, that's something I can't 
compromise on.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk. What do you mean, Trainer...?!

I hurriedly caught her as she collapsed to 
her knees.

Her body had virtually zero strength left 
in it.
choice_data_list: I'm so sorry it turned out like this...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Stop it, that's enough. I get it 
already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry for losing my cool. I never 
wanted to make you make a face like 
that...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ! How is Brian feeling—
choice_data_list: About that matter...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Understood completely. Brian, you don't 
need to worry about what just happened. No 
need to fret. I'll ask another girl.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Please just rest without worrying about a 
thing. Now, if you'll excuse me."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Don't apologize.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"The one truly at fault is me. ...I was 
the one who let myself fall ill."
And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, Oguri-senpai! President, 
you look wonderful!!"
(KER-CLUNK!)

A breathless back-and-forth between both 
sides. A race between top-tier Umamusume 
captivates everyone, even if it's just a 
mock race.
However, Narita Brian—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Watching through the window, are we?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: How pathetic of me...
choice_data_list: Call out to them
Leave them be

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Stop... I don't need your words of 
comfort.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Falling ill was due to my own 
carelessness. ...Missing out on a race I 
wanted is entirely my responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Let's rebuild your body from the 
fundamentals. So that we never make the 
same mistake twice.

Later on, she underwent a thorough 
examination just in case, but no 
abnormalities were found.

The next day, we resumed training with a 
new regimen. Along with her vow never to 
follow down the same path again—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Losing to the heat, how ridiculous. Do 
you lack grit?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...To think not being able to run would 
be this frustrating...!"

Afterward, Narita Brian stayed glued to 
the screen, watching the races of Symboli 
Rudolf and the others.

Later on, she underwent a thorough 
examination just in case, but no 
abnormalities were found.

Yet her eyes, brimming with frustration, 
symbolized that this summer had left 
behind lingering regret.
